title: 第3章 阴阳门暗流第4章 夜奔破境
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
孙主事走后的第三天，阴阳门的帖子送到了。
帖子是清晨到的。刘叙白当时正在院子里练剑，《悟道剑诀》的基础式他已经练了不下千遍，一剑劈出去，剑锋破空的声响比以前清脆了不少。他收剑回鞘，从阿木手里接过那张烫金帖子，翻开看了一眼，眉头就皱了起来。
“怎么了？”陈砚从墙根底下站起来，凑过来看。
刘叙白把帖子递给他，没说话。
帖子上写得很客气——阴阳门掌教座下外门长老秦怀安秦长老，听闻青石镇有散修俊杰刘叙白、苏清欢二人，修为不俗，品性端正，特发此帖，邀二位上山一叙。言辞之间礼数周全，甚至还夸了几句“年少有为”、“散修楷模”之类的客套话。
但刘叙白看完之后，只觉得后背发凉。
“这不对劲。”陈砚也看出来了，他把帖子翻来覆去看了两遍，脸色沉下来，“阴阳门什么时候对外门散修这么客气过？还长老亲自发帖？叙白哥，这摆明了是鸿门宴。”
刘叙白当然知道。那天孙主事在茶摊上被苏清欢一块令牌逼退，表面上服了软，但那双小眼睛里的不甘和阴沉，他看得一清二楚。这种在宗门里混到主事位置的人，面子比天大，当众被削了脸，绝不可能就这么算了。帖子上的措辞越客气，背后的刀子磨得越快。
“帖子是秦怀安发的，不是孙主事。”刘叙白把帖子拿回来，指着落款上那方殷红的印章，“秦怀安是外门长老，品级比孙主事高两级。孙主事一个外门主事，调不动长老出面。这事要么是孙主事把状告到了上面，要么就是有别的原因。”
“什么原因？”
刘叙白没有回答。他转头看向苏清欢的房间，门关着，里面安安静静，没有任何声响。从黑松林回来之后，苏清欢大部分时间都待在屋里，偶尔出来一趟，也只是在院子里站一会儿，望着北边的山头发呆。她没有主动提起过画梅宗，刘叙白也没有问。但他心里清楚，孙主事回去之后必定会查苏清欢的底细，画梅宗令牌的事也一定会传到上面。阴阳门对他这个炼气二层的散修没兴趣，但他们一定对苏清欢有兴趣。
“我去跟苏姑娘商量一下。”刘叙白把帖子收进怀里，朝苏清欢的房间走去。
苏清欢的门没有关严，留了一条缝。刘叙白敲了敲门框，里面传来一个淡淡的声音：“进来。”
屋里陈设简单，一张木床，一张方桌，两把椅子。苏清欢坐在窗前，手里握着一块白布，正在擦拭她那柄细长的青锋剑。剑身已经被擦得锃亮，映出她清冷的眉眼。她抬头看了刘叙白一眼，目光在他怀里的帖子上一扫而过，放下了手里的布。
“阴阳门的帖子？”她问。
“你知道？”
“阿木送帖子来的时候我听见了。”苏清欢的语气平淡，像是在说一件与己无关的事，“秦怀安请我们上山，你打算怎么办？”
刘叙白在她对面坐下来，把帖子摊在桌上：“不能不去。”
苏清欢抬了抬眼皮，等他继续说。
“秦怀安是外门长老，他亲自发帖请两个散修上山，我们如果不去，就是敬酒不吃吃罚酒。孙主事上次退让是因为在镇上，有镇民围观，他不好硬来。但如果我们给了阴阳门发难的由头，下次来的人就不是孙主事了，是执法堂。”刘叙白把帖子上关键的字句指给苏清欢看，“帖子用的是‘邀’，不是‘召’。这是给面子。但如果这个面子我们不接，就会变成‘拒’。散修拒宗门长老之邀，传到外面去，阴阳门就有足够的理由对我们动手，连画梅宗的面子都不好使。”

苏清欢沉默了一会儿：“你说的没错。”
“但去了也有风险。秦怀安这个人我没见过，不知道他是什么路数。如果是孙主事在背后撺掇的，上山就是自投罗网。”刘叙白的手指在桌面上轻轻敲了两下，这是他思考时的习惯动作，“所以得做两手准备。”
“什么准备？”
刘叙白没有马上回答。他掏出手机，在桌下点开了墟市。灰蒙蒙的雾气中，货架上那张遁地符还安安静静地躺在收藏夹里，价格二十枚下品灵石，他还没凑够。但他的目光跳过了遁地符，落在了另一个东西上——一枚拇指盖大小的黑色丹丸，表面粗糙，散发着一层淡淡的灰光，下面标着：“瘴烟丸，下品，捏碎后释放剧毒瘴气，覆盖方圆十丈，持续时间三十息，售价十五枚下品灵石。”
十五枚。刘叙白咬了咬牙。他手头的灵石在买完《悟道剑诀》之后只剩下不到二十枚，这十五枚花出去，他就又回到赤贫状态了。但阴阳门这一趟，没有底牌兜底，他不敢上山。
“我有办法。”刘叙白收起手机，面上不动声色，“你信我吗？”
苏清欢看着他，那双清冷的眼睛里没有犹豫，只有一种很淡的、近乎于理所当然的笃定。
“信。”
一个字，轻飘飘的，却让刘叙白心里莫名地暖了一下。他站起来，把帖子收好：“那就明天一早动身。叫上陈砚，他在山下接应，不上山。”
“陈砚不会答应。”苏清欢说，“他那个人，你让他躲在外面看你上山涉险，比打他一顿还难受。”
刘叙白当然知道。陈砚这个人，贪小财、怕惹事、嘴还碎，但真到了要命的时候，他绝对会挡在前面。可正因为这样，刘叙白才更不能让他上山。阴阳门是龙潭虎穴，他和苏清欢两个人进去，至少还有令牌护身，陈砚一个炼气三层的散修跟上去，纯粹是送人头。
“我不让他上山，他会听。”刘叙白说完这句话，推门出去了。
当天晚上，刘叙白把陈砚叫到院子里，把事情原原本本说了一遍。陈砚一听就炸了，死活要跟着上山，说两个人太少，多一个人多一分照应。刘叙白没有跟他争，只是问他：“如果我们三个都折在山上，谁去画梅宗报信？”
陈砚愣住了。
content_en:
On the third day after Master Sun left, the message from the Yin and Yang Sect arrived.
The post arrived early in the morning. Liu Xubai was practicing swordplay in the yard at that time. He had practiced the basic postures of "Enlightenment Sword Art" no less than a thousand times. When he struck out with his sword, the sound of the sword cutting through the air was much clearer than before. He sheathed his sword, took the gold-gilt post from Amu's hand, opened it and took a look, then frowned.
"What's wrong?" Chen Yan stood up from under the wall and came over to take a look.
Liu Xubai handed him the post without saying a word.
The post was written very politely - Elder Qin Huaian, the elder of the outer sect under the headmaster of the Yin and Yang Sect, heard that there were two outstanding figures of loose cultivators in Qingshi Town, Liu Xubai and Su Qinghuan. His words were polite and courteous, and he even praised him with some polite words such as "a promising young man" and "a model for casual cultivators".
But after reading it, Liu Xubai only felt a chill on his back.
"This is not right." Chen Yan also noticed it. He read the post over and over again, and his face darkened, "When has the Yin Yang Sect ever been so polite to the outer sect's loose cultivators? And the elder posted it himself? Brother Xu Bai, this is clearly the Hongmen Banquet."
Of course Liu Xubai knew. That day, Mr. Sun was forced to retreat by Su Qinghuan with a token at the tea stall. On the surface, he was subdued, but he could clearly see the unwillingness and gloominess in his small eyes. This kind of person who has sneaked into the position of chief executive in the sect has a huge reputation. If his face is shaved in public, there is no way he can just let it go. The more polite the wording in the post, the faster the knife in the back is sharpened.
"The post was sent by Qin Huaian, not Principal Sun." Liu Xubai took the post back and pointed to Fang Yinhong's seal on the signature, "Qin Huaian is an elder of the outer sect, and his rank is two levels higher than Principal Sun. Principal Sun is an outer sect principal, and he can't get the elders to come forward. Either Principal Sun brought the complaint to the higher-ups, or there are other reasons."
"What's the reason?"
Liu Xubai did not answer. He turned to look at Su Qinghuan's room. The door was closed and it was quiet inside without any sound. After returning from the black pine forest, Su Qinghuan stayed in the house most of the time. Occasionally he came out and just stood in the yard for a while, staring blankly at the mountains to the north. She didn't take the initiative to mention Hua Mei Zong, and Liu Xubai didn't ask. But he knew in his heart that Master Sun would definitely investigate Su Qinghuan's details after he returned, and the matter of painting the Mei Zong token would definitely be spread to the higher ups. The Yin and Yang Sect is not interested in him, a casual cultivator on the second level of Qi Refining, but they must be interested in Su Qinghuan.
"I'll go discuss it with Miss Su." Liu Xubai put the post in his arms and walked towards Su Qinghuan's room.
Su Qinghuan's door was not closed tightly, leaving a crack. Liu Xubai knocked on the door frame, and a faint voice came from inside: "Come in."
The room is simply furnished, with a wooden bed, a square table and two chairs. Su Qinghuan was sitting in front of the window, holding a white cloth in her hand and wiping her slender green-edged sword. The blade of the sword had been polished to a shine, reflecting her cold brows. She raised her head and glanced at Liu Xubai, her eyes swept across the post in his arms, and put down the cloth in her hand.
"Posts on Yin Yang Gate?" she asked.
"You know?"
"I heard it when Amu sent the post." Su Qinghuan's tone was calm, as if she was talking about something that had nothing to do with her. "Qin Huaian invited us to go up the mountain. What are you going to do?"
Liu Xubai sat down opposite her and spread the post on the table: "I have to go."
Su Qinghuan raised her eyelids and waited for him to continue.
"Qin Huaian is the elder of the outer sect. He personally posted a message to invite two casual cultivators to go up the mountain. If we don't go, we will be toasted instead of fined wine. Chief Sun gave in last time because there were townspeople watching in the town, and he couldn't force it. But if we give the Yin and Yang Sect a reason to attack, the person who comes next time will not be Chief Sun, but the Law Enforcement Hall." Liu Xubai pointed out the key words on the post to Su Qinghuan, "The post saidThe word Zi uses is "invite", not "call". This is to give face. But if we don’t accept this face, it will become ‘rejection’. If the casual cultivator refuses the invitation of the elders of the sect and spreads the news outside, the Yin and Yang Sect will have enough reason to take action against us, and it will not even be possible to save the Mei Sect's face. "
Su Qinghuan was silent for a while: "You are right. "
“But there are risks involved. I have never met Qin Huaian, so I don’t know who he is. If Master Sun was behind it, going up the mountain would be a trap. Liu Xubai tapped his fingers on the table twice, which was his habitual action when thinking, "So you have to be prepared." "
"What preparation? "
Liu Xubai did not answer immediately. He took out his mobile phone and opened the market under the table. In the gray mist, the Earth Escape Talisman on the shelf was still lying quietly in his favorites. The price was twenty low-grade spiritual stones, but he hadn't gotten enough. But his eyes skipped the Earth Escape Talisman and fell on another object - a black pill the size of a thumb cap, with a rough surface and a faint gray light. It was marked below: "Miasma Smoke Pill, low grade. After crushing, it releases highly toxic miasma. It covers a radius of ten feet, lasts for thirty breaths, and sells for fifteen low grade spiritual stones." "
Fifteen. Liu Xubai gritted his teeth. After buying the "Sword Art of Enlightenment", he had less than twenty spiritual stones left. After spending these fifteen, he would be back in abject poverty. But on this trip to the Yin-Yang Gate, he didn't dare go up the mountain without a trump card.
"I have a solution. "Liu Xubai put away his phone, his face expressionless, "Do you believe me? "
Su Qinghuan looked at him, there was no hesitation in those cold eyes, only a very faint, almost natural certainty.
"Letter. "
One word, light and fluttering, made Liu Xubai feel inexplicably warm in his heart. He stood up and put the post away: "Then we will leave early tomorrow morning. Call Chen Yan, he will take care of you at the foot of the mountain and will not go up the mountain. "
"Chen Yan will not agree. Su Qinghuan said, "That guy, if you let him hide outside and watch you go up the mountain and take risks, it would be more uncomfortable than beating him up." "
Of course Liu Xubai knew. Chen Yan is a person who is greedy for small money, afraid of getting into trouble, and can be rude, but when it comes to his life, he will definitely stand in front of him. But precisely because of this, Liu Xubai couldn't let him go up the mountain. The Yin and Yang Gate was a dragon's pond and a tiger's den. When he and Su Qinghuan went in, at least they had tokens to protect themselves. Chen Yan, a casual cultivator at the third level of Qi Refining, followed them, just to give away their lives.
“I wouldn’t let him go up the mountain, and he would listen. "After Liu Xubai said this, he opened the door and went out.
That night, Liu Xubai called Chen Yan to the yard and told him everything. Chen Yan was furious when he heard this, and wanted to follow him up the mountain. He said that two people were too few, and one more person would be more helpful. Liu Xubai did not argue with him, but just asked him: "If the three of us are folded on the mountain, who will go to Hua Mei Zong to report the news? "
Chen Yan was stunned.
